basis: Written from the published specification and established practice in the field; no new sources were read. Unreviewed.

distinguishingFeatures: A scoped review case for one subject in one work context, not a lifelong score for a person.
Separates objectives, evidence, assessment, calibration and contest as distinct records.
Differs from employment and pay records: decisions based on it live elsewhere.
Supports non-employee contexts such as contractors and founders without forcing a rating scale.

may: Collect and cite evidence with its quality and attribution.
Summarize evidence for a human reviewer.
mustNot: Issue a rating or outcome without an accountable human author.
Use activity or surveillance data as the sole basis for assessment.
Treat missing evidence as zero contribution.
Make or trigger hiring, promotion, dismissal or pay decisions.
Disclose reviews beyond the stated purpose.

considerations: Performance reviews affect livelihoods and must be fair, explained and contestable.
Bias in evaluations can follow gender, ethnicity, disability or caring responsibilities.
Monitoring-based metrics intrude on privacy and may misrepresent contribution.
affectedParties: Teams whose shared work is attributed

items: A review case has a subject, work context, period, objectives and an issuing authority.
Confused with an employment record, a 360 feedback survey, productivity dashboards and a disciplinary case.
Unfair outcomes from biased or proxy evidence.
Leak of reviews to unauthorized colleagues.
ISO 8601 date and time for review periods.
